g.text: 42a · Microservice distributed tracing and span instrumentation
Dispatch HTTP/RPC request with W3C traceparent header
Extract parent trace ID andinitialize root execution span
Execute business logic; createnested child spans for DB & RPCcalls
Emit completed OpenTelemetry span records via gRPC
Record AI generation metadata (Prompt tokens, completion tokens, model latency)
Return operation response with trace-id in response header
Correlated distributed spans allow end-to-end latency and error attribution across all microservices
